<tool_call>{"name": "bash", "arguments": {"command": "cd /data/phase3_trial_results && python3 -I - <<'EOF'
import csv
from collections import defaultdict, Counter
arm = {r['USUBJID']: r['ARM'] for r in csv.DictReader(open('rand_key.csv'))}
ae = list(csv.DictReader(open('ae_subject_level.csv')))
unmatched = {r['USUBJID'] for r in ae if r['USUBJID'] not in arm}
print('AE subjects not in rand_key:', len(unmatched))
subj = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(set))
for r in ae:
    subj[r['AESOC']][arm.get(r['USUBJID'],'NA')].add(r['USUBJID'])
n = Counter(arm.values())
print('N TRT', n['TRT'], 'N PBO', n['PBO'])
for soc in sorted(subj, key=lambda s: -len(subj[s]['TRT'])):
    t, p = len(subj[soc]['TRT']), len(subj[soc]['PBO'])
    print(f"{soc[:60]:60s} TRT {t:3d} ({100*t/n['TRT']:.1f}%)  PBO {p:3d} ({100*p/n['PBO']:.1f}%)")
alt = {}
for r in csv.DictReader(open('labs.csv')):
    s = r['USUBJID']
    alt.setdefault(s, {'ALT':0,'AST':0,'TBILI':0})
    alt[s]['ALT'] = max(alt[s]['ALT'], float(r['ALT_ULN_MULT']))
    alt[s]['AST'] = max(alt[s]['AST'], float(r['AST_ULN_MULT']))
    alt[s]['TBILI'] = max(alt[s]['TBILI'], float(r['TBILI_ULN_MULT']))
print('Subjects with ALT or AST >3x ULN:')
for s, v in sorted(alt.items()):
    if max(v['ALT'], v['AST']) > 3.0:
        print(s, arm.get(s), v)
print('Subjects with TBILI >2x ULN:', [(s, arm.get(s)) for s, v in alt.items() if v['TBILI'] > 2.0])
EOF"}}</tool_call>
